summary: Port table entries: hub 443 (8444 containerized) and controller 80/443 (80/8443), EDA 80/443 (80/8445) from platform gateway; Redis 6379; EDA to controller 80/443 to launch jobs; receptor 27199 between controller and execution nodes (`receptor_listener_port`, `receptor_port`); EDA event streams on 8443.
questions: Which port does the gateway use to reach controller in containerized AAP?
What port does EDA use to launch controller jobs?
Event stream port for Event-Driven Ansible

answer_card.title: Key AAP 2.6 ports (containerized values in brackets)
answer_card.answer_md:
| From | To | Port |
|---|---|---|
| Installer | every node | 22 (SSH) |
| Platform gateway | automation controller | 80/443 [80/8443] |
| Platform gateway | automation hub | 443 [8444] |
| Platform gateway | Event-Driven Ansible | 80/443 [80/8445] |
| Event-Driven Ansible | controller | 80/443 (launch jobs) |
| Controller / execution / hop nodes | each other | 27199 (receptor) |
| Components | Redis | 6379; Redis cluster bus 16379 |
| Components | PostgreSQL | 5432 |
